# /backlog — Displays a consolidated backlog view from all sources (external tracker, discovery, healthcheck, code TODOs, review findings, manual entries). Supports filtering and multiple output formats for CLI and future UI consumption.

## When to Use

Invoke this command when the user requests or implies the
`backlog` operation.

## Purpose

Displays a consolidated backlog view from all sources (external tracker, discovery, healthcheck, code TODOs, review findings, manual entries). Supports filtering and multiple output formats for CLI and future UI consumption.

## Shared State

This command participates in the shared workflow state. Read and update:

- **AGENT_BACKLOG.md** — Prioritized work items; read before starting, update when adding/completing tasks
- **.windsurf/state/orchestrator.json** — Phase, team status, metrics; read for context
- **.windsurf/state/events.log** — Append a log line when completing significant actions

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Default |
|------|-------------|---------|
| `--format` | Output format: table, json, yaml, csv | table |
| `--team` | Filter by team | — |
| `--priority` | Filter by priority (P0, P1, P2, P3) | — |
| `--source` | Filter by source (github, linear, discovery, todo, review, manual) | — |
| `--status` | Filter by status (open, in-progress, completed, blocked) | — |
| `--sort` | Sort by field (priority, team, source, updated) | priority |
